title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
summary: A boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle learns its laws from a bear and a panther while a tiger wants him dead. The book also contains several unconnected animal stories.
readIf: you like classic animal adventure with real stakes and a strong jungle atmosphere.
skipIf: you expect the film; the original is more serious, and reflects colonial attitudes of its time.

pairings.reason: Another story in which animals have their own laws, dangers and culture, with a tougher heart.
A calmer animal classic with similar charm and a love of landscape.
Another short adventure from the same era that does not talk down to young readers.
